title: The Dried Gourd
subtitle: An empty vessel
text: Lay gourds and Venous Stone in a checker five blocks wide, five deep and three high. Hold Gourd Seeds in your offhand and hold Blood Projection on a gourd until 150 mL has gone in, and the structure dries into a Dried Gourd. It needs no floor and no Degree. The Rite of the Pallid Vessel wakes it into a blood gourd (see Blood Gourds), and the Scarlet Vanity takes one as an offering.
